# staticform_api_key (Resource)

A StaticForm API key. The plaintext key is returned only at creation time and stored in state; mark your state as sensitive accordingly.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "staticform_api_key" "ci" {
  name       = "ci-pipeline"
  expires_at = "2027-01-01T00:00:00Z"

  # Every endpoint has its own permission; list each one the key needs.
  permissions = [
    "User.Forms.GetById",
    "User.Submissions.ListAll",
    "User.Submissions.GetUnreadCount",
  ]
}

output "api_key" {
  value     = staticform_api_key.ci.key
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable name for the key.

### Optional

- `expires_at` (String) Optional RFC 3339 expiration timestamp (e.g. `2027-01-01T00:00:00Z`). Omit for a non-expiring key. Immutable; changing it forces a new key.
- `form_ids` (Set of String) Form IDs to scope the key to. Omit for all of the user's forms. A restricted provider key can only grant form scopes within its own. Updatable in place.
- `permissions` (Set of String) `User.*` permission names to scope the key to, as listed by the `staticform_api_key_permissions` data source. Names are used exactly as written, and every endpoint has its own permission. Historical product names are translated to every per-endpoint permission that replaced them. Omit to inherit the owner's delegable permissions. The key used by the provider must hold every permission granted here. Explicit empty sets are rejected to avoid converting legacy deny-all configuration into owner-wide access. Updatable in place.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) The plaintext API key. Available only immediately after creation.
- `key_hint` (String) Last characters of the key, for identification.
